**Q3 2026 retention (signup cohorts Jul–Sep, 354 users)**
• D7: **87.6%** · D14: **76.6%** · D30: **64.4%** (D1: 100%)
• By month (D30): Jul 62.8% · Aug 67.8% · Sep 62.6%. The July cohort had the best D7 (92.6%), but August held on best by D30.
Retained at Day N = any event N or more days after signup. Source: `users_data`, data through 2026-11-11.
